decisions.title: Ex-works cost vs target — integration depth deferred
decisions.note: The engine's honest bottom-up at the brief's 5,000-unit batch with a fully bought-out BoM lands materially above the £8,500 ex-works target (market band £300-700/kWh is achieved by manufacturers through power-electronics INTEGRATION: inverter, converters, BMS and monitoring as one custom manufactured board-set, plus contract-volume cell pricing). Decision (Tristan, 2026-07-10): DISCLOSE the gap as a commercial finding rather than model integration depth now; the integrated-assembly costing capability is deferred to a future engine workstream.
decisions.scope: commercial/cost — does not alter any engineering quantity, verdict, or physical design
